meta.title: Lunia | Riyadh's Skin Quality Center
meta.description: Diagnostic-led skin, hair & scalp, and post-surgery recovery care in Riyadh, built on a Korean-inspired philosophy. Not facials — skin quality, sustained.

positioning.heading: Not a spa. A Skin Quality Center.
positioning.body: A facial fades by the weekend. Skin quality is something you build — layer by layer, session by session — until it holds its own glow. At Lunia, every visit begins with a real diagnostic read of your skin, not a menu of treatments, so what we do next is calibrated to what your skin actually needs, and sustained long enough to show.

services.heading: Three departments, one philosophy
services.intro: Skin, hair & scalp, and post-surgery recovery — each built on the same diagnostic-first approach to lasting quality.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.body: We start by reading your skin, or scalp, closely — diagnostic imaging and a real conversation, not guesswork.

steps.title: Personalize
steps.body: A plan is built around what we find, not a fixed treatment menu.

steps.title: Treat
steps.body: Clinical-grade protocols, delivered in a calm, luminous space.

steps.title: Relax
steps.body: Recovery matters as much as treatment — time to let the work settle.

steps.title: Maintain
steps.body: A steady rhythm of visits keeps progress compounding instead of fading.

steps.title: Return
steps.body: Skin quality is sustained, not a one-time result — we track it with you, visit after visit.

brands.heading: Clinical-grade brands we stand behind
brands.intro: We only bring in names we'd recommend to our own families — chosen for results, not trends.

items.quote: For the first time, someone actually explained what my skin needed instead of just selling me a facial.
items.author: N., Riyadh

items.quote: Six months in and my skin genuinely looks different — not just after a treatment, but every day.
items.author: L., Riyadh

items.quote: The recovery lounge after surgery was the calmest, most careful care I could have asked for.
items.author: H., Riyadh
